lesson_title: The Problem Every Single Person on Earth Has
hook_text: Every person on Earth, rich or poor, has the same problem. Here it is in one picture.
clip_script: Kabelo gets R100 for his birthday. His wish list: soccer ball, data, calculator, burger, phone cover, movie ticket. Total: over R600. Long list, short money. Economists call that scarcity: wants are unlimited, resources are limited. Even billionaires have it, because they only get twenty-four hours a day. So Kabelo ranks the list. Calculator first, he has a maths test. Then data for homework. That leaves ten rand. The ball has to wait. And that ball is the hidden price of his choice, the opportunity cost. Every choice you make costs you the next best thing. Choose like an economist.
visual_style: A whiteboard wish list that keeps growing off the screen next to a single R100 note, then a ranked list with the soccer ball crossed out and labelled opportunity cost.
mood: Relatable and clever, an everyday dilemma with a big idea.
pacing: Fast list growth, a pause on the R100, then a calm ranking.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and name the opportunity cost of the last thing you bought.
